notes.title: Early Access Update #5 – v0.9.1 Is Live
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Our fifth major Early Access update is here, and it’s all about speed, precision, and fresh challenges.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🕒 [b]New Mode: Speedrun[/b][/h2][p]Speedrun Mode is now available.[/p][p]No cutscenes, no intermissions, just pure gameplay and a ticking clock. Set your best time and climb the brand-new Speedrun leaderboards. [/p][p][i]Note: Speedrun Mode unlocks after completing the first Story Mode level (The Nest). This is a temporary setup and will be streamlined in the future.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🗺️ [b]Four New Story Mode Levels[/b][/h2][p]We’ve expanded the campaign with one new level per chapter, all fully playable in both Story and Speedrun Modes:[/p][list][*][p]Chapter 1: Dark Waters[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter 2: Healthcare Part 2[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter 3: Bridge[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter 4: Resolution Part 1[/p][/*][/list][p][i]We recommend starting a fresh save file to ensure clean progression with the latest content.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🏆 [b]Bullet Noir is a Collision Awards Finalist[/b][/h2][p]We’re proud to announce that Bullet Noir is a finalist in two categories at the 2025 Collision Awards.[/p][p]You can help us win. Cast your votes here:[/p][p][b] [/b][url="https://vote.collisionawards.com/PublicVoting#/2025/games-xr/best-in-style" style="button"]Vote for Best in Style[/url][b]  [/b][url="https://vote.collisionawards.com/PublicVoting#/2025/games-xr/craft" style="button"]Vote for Best in Craft[/url][/p][p]Thanks for being part of this journey and helping us get here.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]☀️ [b]Steam Summer Sale – 20% Off Until July 10[/b][/h2][p]Bullet Noir is now 20% off as part of the Steam Summer Sale.[/p][p]If you’ve been waiting to dive in, now’s the time.
Experience the new Speedrun Mode, take on fresh levels, and see how far you can climb.[/p][p]We’ve got more updates on the way. Until then, thank you for your support and feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204960/Bullet_Noir/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: May Recap - New Updates, Patches, Modes and Music. Same Firepower.
notes.content:
May was packed with heat, chaos, and major additions for Bullet Noir. If you missed anything, here’s a quick breakdown of [b]everything we launched this month[/b]:

[h3]🎯 Update #2 – Leaderboards, The Priest, and Controller Tweaks[/h3]
Release Date: May 8, 2025
The second Early Access update sharpened the core experience:
[list][*] Story Mode Leaderboards are live! Compete globally or with friends to claim your spot as the ultimate run-and-gun assassin.
[*] The Priest has descended into Arcade Mode. Wield divine justice with holy wrath.
[*] Controller support improved – loading screen prompts now match your device.[/list]
[b]🛠️ Full patch version: 0.8.7[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/3204960/announcements/detail/521964845255361953
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🎵 Bullet Noir Original Soundtrack – Now Available[/h3]
Release Date: May 20, 2025
Immerse yourself in the sound of vengeance. The official Bullet Noir OST by acclaimed composer Cosmin Mirza is out now, featuring 16 pulse-pounding tracks that fuel every firefight and frantic escape.
[list][*] 🎧 Includes music from the game
[*] 🕹️ Credits include Door Kickers 2 and Trinity Fusion
[*] 💿 Available on Steam and YouTube[/list]
[previewyoutube=C-D-wP7d-pw;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🔥 Update #3 – Feats, Keybindings, and More Customization[/h3]
Release Date: May 29, 2025
The third update doubled down on score chasers and player flexibility:
[list][*] 10 new scoring feats to unlock mid-run
[*] On-screen notifications for every scoring milestone
[*] Full Keybinding support for Mouse & Keyboard
[*] Two Controller Templates for Xbox & PlayStation-style setups[/list]
[b]🛠️ Full patch version: 0.8.8[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/3204960/announcements/detail/521966748731179695
[hr][/hr]
💬 What’s Next?
More content is on the way. Your feedback continues to shape the road ahead—thank you for walking this dark path with us. Stay tuned for the next update.

➡️ Also, [b]Bullet Noir is 15% off for a limited time.[/b] Now’s the perfect time to grab your guns and join the hunt. Wishlist. Play. Spread the word.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204960/Bullet_Noir/

notes.title: Bullet Noir - Early Access Update #1
notes.content:
[h2]Our first Early Access update for Bullet Noir is live! [/h2]

[h3]Here’s what’s new under the flickering streetlights and constant rain:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Arcade Mode is now unlocked for the Doctor[/b]. It's time to test your skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/a41cc02f3e2b50eee4792cadb21b449079d23a9a.png[/img]
[*] [b]Cinematics have been sharpened[/b] with new voice-overs and richer visuals, pulling you deeper into the shadows.
[*] A new [b]Mini-Boss[/b] prowls the alleys: a fast-moving, close-quarters bruiser. Drop them with 2 pistol shots, 1 shotgun blast, or a melee strike... if you’re quick enough.
[*] [b]Loading Screen Tips[/b] were added to keep you sharp between runs.
[*] The Menu and Score Screen got a fresh coat of paint: slicker, sharper, and ready for business.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/47f24c3fab88c83c09e542e963ee0f80be7a3ed4.png[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Thank you for playing and supporting us! Stay tuned, more updates are on the way! [/h3]

[h3][b]Buy or wishlist now:[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204960/Bullet_Noir/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/0b2cceeab9cf7ff35dcc7648e9fe577a1c101180.png[/img]
